## What's new: a faster Review and Brain health, and every rule in the brief

### Faster

- **Review opens faster.** With many tasks waiting, Moah drafts their reviews all at once instead of one by one, so the screen loads in less than half the time. The drafts are the same as before.
- **Brain health opens about a third faster,** with the same shelf suggestions.

### Rules

- **Every rule in the brief.** An agent's start-up brief lists the title of every project rule, not only the first 12.
- **Rules stay short.** A new rule can have a title of up to 120 characters and a text of up to 1,200. Memory shows a counter, and an agent that tries a longer rule is told to shorten it or split it in two. Rules written before this version keep their length: they can be shortened, not lengthened. Other kinds of memory have no limit.

### Agents

- **The Claude desktop app leaves terminal sessions alone.** A desktop app chat that starts at the same moment as a Claude Code session in a terminal no longer takes over that session's project and task.
- **Chats in the Claude desktop app share their task on purpose.** The MCP guide explains how this works and how to keep a chat's work apart.

### After updating

Quit Moah from the tray and open it again, then restart agent sessions that were already running.
